task_cases.answer: Tyler says he beat Metroid and Battle of Olympus, and revises his earlier easy-Metroid impression to a good difficulty curve. He has already played Neutopia, while Neutopia II and Astyanax are upcoming. Crusader of Centy is a proposed next game. Golden Axe Warrior is different again: he explicitly does not own it and has failed to get the UPC variant at a price he likes.

task_cases.question: Why compare Battle of Olympus with both Zelda II and Simon's Quest?
task_cases.query: Battle Olympus Zelda 2 Simon quest Crystalis Game Boy
task_cases.answer: They separate movement and appearance from structure: the jump, combat and visual feel evoke Zelda II, while wandering an open 2D world and solving mysteries remind them of Simon's Quest. They also discuss a reportedly close Game Boy version and Johnny recommends Crystalis; Tyler says his old attempt at Crystalis felt repetitive. Their release-date and conversion-history details are uncertain host claims.

task_cases.question: Did Tyler and Ada actually play the recommended co-op game that night?
task_cases.query: Divinity Original Sin Ada Lego Harry Potter Dimensions Minecraft plan
task_cases.answer: The episode establishes plans, not a completed session. Johnny suggests LEGO Harry Potter's PS4 collection, but Tyler says LEGO Dimensions burned him out on LEGO games and leans toward Divinity: Original Sin. Minecraft is a joking fallback. Earlier he had only said he would probably buy Divinity, so neither purchase nor play should be treated as finished.
